name: venue_avg_first_inn
construction: Mean of earlier-date first-innings totals at this venue; earlier league mean if none

name: venue_sd_first_inn
construction: Sample SD of earlier-date venue totals; earlier league SD if fewer than two

name: venue_prior_matches
construction: Count of first innings played at this venue on earlier dates

name: venue_boundary_rate
construction: Mean earlier venue innings boundary-delivery fraction, including all delivery events; earlier league fallback

name: season_index
construction: Calendar season year minus the earliest source year, plus the index offset

name: toss_winner_batting_first
construction: Binary indicator that the toss winner is the team batting first, checked against toss decision

name: bat_average
construction: XI mean of player bat runs divided by at least one dismissal; sparse histories blend with earlier league rates

name: bat_strike_rate
construction: XI mean of player bat runs per hundred faced balls; wides excluded from faced balls

name: bat_boundary_pct
construction: XI mean of actual boundary events per hundred faced balls; running fours excluded

name: bat_top_order_sr
description: Strike rate of three XI players with earliest historical batting positions
construction: Mean strike rate of the three XI players with earliest historical mean batting positions; registry IDs break ties

name: bat_depth
description: XI count with historical strike rate above threshold
construction: Count of XI players whose earlier shrunken career strike rate exceeds the saved depth threshold

name: team_last10_total
description: Team mean of most recent historical first innings
construction: Mean of the team's most recent earlier first innings, up to the saved history window; league fallback

name: bowl_economy
construction: Opposition XI mean charged runs per over of legal balls; byes, leg-byes and penalties excluded

name: bowl_strike_rate
description: Opposition XI mean bowling strike rate
construction: Opposition XI mean legal balls divided by at least one bowler-credited wicket

name: bowl_dot_pct
construction: Opposition XI mean percent of legal deliveries conceding no total runs

name: bowl_wickets_match
description: Opposition XI mean wickets per bowling appearance
construction: Opposition XI mean credited wickets per match with a bowling appearance, rather than per XI selection

name: bowl_death_economy
construction: Opposition XI mean charged runs per over in the final scheduled overs; sparse death-ball history blends with league rate
